item.title: Episode 3: Shadows in the Night - The Tithe
item.description:

Maren, Bridget, Elspeth, and Gareth find themselves caught between reality and a supernatural force that demands a price for silence. This episode features top-tier voice acting, binaural sound design that places you inside the story, an original score that builds tension with each knock, and eerie sound effects that bring the haunted mansion to life. Listeners are warned of intense horror elements, including themes of sacrifice and supernatural entities.
